verdict.rationale: Retention and PII deletion are applicable questions for an identity-verification platform like AiPrise, but nothing in the evidence pack covers them. There are no documented retention windows, no data-deletion or redaction endpoint, and no on-demand PII scrubbing. The general API, workflow, and access-management items are about different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
